summaries.en: Last30days-skill is an AI agent that researches trending topics across platforms like Reddit, X, and YouTube to generate grounded summaries, addressing information overload by filtering recent, relevant content. It works by aggregating data from diverse sources including social media and prediction markets, then synthesizes insights using AI to highlight key trends and discussions. You can use it to track emerging topics in your field, experiment by customizing source inputs, or integrate it into workflows for automated research and analysis.
summaries.zh: Last30days-skill 是一个 AI 智能体，专门研究 Reddit、X、YouTube 等平台上的热门话题，生成基于事实的摘要，帮助用户应对信息过载问题。它通过聚合社交媒体和预测市场等多源数据，利用 AI 技术筛选近期内容并综合关键趋势与讨论。使用时，你可以用它追踪所在领域的新兴话题，通过自定义数据源进行实验，或将其集成到工作流中实现自动化研究，从而快速获取有价值的洞察。

summaries.en: Editor is an open-source TypeScript tool that enables users to create and share 3D architectural projects directly in the browser. Its technical strength lies in implementing real-time 3D rendering and collaborative editing capabilities through web technologies, allowing architectural visualization without specialized software. Developers can integrate it into existing workflows or extend its functionality for custom architectural design applications, making professional 3D modeling accessible through standard web interfaces.
summaries.zh: Editor是一款基于TypeScript的开源工具，让用户能够在浏览器中直接创建和分享三维建筑项目。它通过Web技术实现实时三维渲染和协同编辑功能，使建筑可视化无需依赖专业软件即可完成。该项目的核心价值在于将复杂的建筑建模流程简化为网页操作，开发者可将其集成到现有工作流中，或扩展功能用于定制化建筑设计应用，为建筑设计和展示提供了轻量级的技术解决方案。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
